newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia may allow mining in forests - paper.
newsitem.headline: Australia may allow mining in forests - paper.

text.p: Australia will consider allowing mineral exploration and mining in protected forests, The Australian Financial Review newspaper reported on Thursday.

The newspaper said cabinet would next week consider a plan to allow mining activity in areas protected under the national reserve system, which sets aside environmentally-valuable forests under an agreement between Canberra and state governments.
The government proposal has the backing of the mining industry, but appears set to spark a row with conservationists, the paper said.
The special national reserve system sets aside 15 percent of pre-European settlement forest cover for each forest type.
Agreement has not yet been reached between the national government and state governments on areas to be protected under the scheme.
